## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a relevant issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the commands run and observed results. Mark anything not run explicitly.

## Evidence boundaries

- [ ] No API keys, private logs or local acquisition caches are included.
- [ ] Offline, mocked, cached-hosted and fresh-hosted results are distinguished.
- [ ] Changed simulator/model/reward behavior uses a new experiment directory.
- [ ] Recovery remains independently verified; test results are not used to select checkpoints.
